subject: [PATCH 13/60] mm/compaction: restrict compaction to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series is a good start, but it would be helpful to have more information on the performance benefits and any potential drawbacks of restricting compaction to common memory nodes.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts compaction to common memory nodes, improving performance and reducing unnecessary work on memoryless nodes. The changes are made in the mm/compaction.c and mm/memory_hotplug.c files, where the for_each_online_node() macro is replaced with for_each_node_state(nid, N_MEMORY_COMMON) to limit compaction to common nodes.
